$comment: Advisories the security workflow tolerates in `npm audit --omit=dev`. Each entry needs a reason, the date it was added and an expiry; an expired entry fails the gate so it is looked at again. Reviewed 2026-10-03 (findings register CI-05). All four sit in Expo build and dev-client tooling (CLI, config plugins, router query parsing), not in code that handles family data. Never run `npm audit fix --force`.

ignore.reason: Build tool only: file globbing in the Expo CLI and Metro on the developer machine and CI. Patterns are ours, not user input. Waits for an Expo release with a fixed micromatch.
Build tool only: Expo CLI code signing for development updates. The app does not use node-forge at runtime. Waits for an Expo release with node-forge above 1.4.0.
Below the high gate today; listed so a severity change is a reviewed decision. Deep links are allowlisted before routing (WS-11). Waits for expo-router to move off query-string 7.
Build tool only: Xcode project editing during prebuild. We never pass a buffer to uuid v3/v5/v6. Below the high gate today; listed for the same reason as above.
